event_type.description: REVIEW_CORRECTIONS (schema sync, control WO EX-CTRL-LINTSCHEMA-R1) is the dedicated post-terminal review-corrections marker; scripts/harness/work_cli.py additionally requires it to appear only after the terminal/handoff event and to be authored by REVIEWER, VERIFIER or DIRECTOR (docs/infra/VALIDATION_GATES_R1.md section 2).

subject_sha.description: Strictly a full 40-hex git SHA for every event. Known accepted divergence: scripts/harness/work_cli.py (the enforcement floor) tolerates the abbreviated 7-hex value 9cc83e8 ONLY for the four immutable legacy events whitelisted in LEGACY_ABBREVIATED_SHA_EVENTS (EX-NL1-002-R1 events 0002-0005) that are already published on canonical main; those four events remain invalid by this schema (this schema is the ceiling). See config/control/harness/README.md.
